info.name: Pied Web scheduled mail sender
info.summary: Sends the messages NextSnapMail scheduled, without a browser
info.description: Reads the Scheduled folder of each mailbox whose NextSnapMail credentials are stored in Nextcloud, and hands every message that is due to the account's own SMTP server. It claims a message before sending it, so an interrupted run reports instead of sending twice. No message, recipient or credential is stored by this app.
info.author: Robin Delattre
